# United Nations
> The official website of the United Nations, covering global peace and security, sustainable development, human rights, humanitarian action, and international law.

The United Nations website brings together institutional information, news, official documents, campaigns, and topic hubs for the UN Secretariat, principal organs, and major global initiatives. It also links to specialized subdomains for country teams, research, peacekeeping, and thematic programs.

## Main UN Site
- [United Nations Home](https://www.un.org/en/): Main entry point for UN news, issues, events, and institutional information.
- [About Us](https://www.un.org/en/about-us): Overview of the UN’s history, purpose, structure, and leadership.
- [Our Work](https://www.un.org/en/our-work): Gateway to the UN’s core areas including peace, rights, and development.
- [Get Involved](https://www.un.org/en/get-involved): Ways for individuals, students, and partners to engage with the UN.
- [Events and News](https://www.un.org/en/events-and-news): Central hub for UN observances, meetings, press, and announcements.
- [Documents](https://www.un.org/en/documents/): Access point for charters, resolutions, reports, and official UN texts.

## Peace, Security, and International Law
- [Peace and Security](https://www.un.org/en/global-issues/peace-and-security): Overview of UN work on conflict prevention, mediation, and peacebuilding.
- [Peacekeeping](https://www.un.org/en/global-issues/peace-and-security): Entry point to UN peace and security activities and related resources.
- [Security Council](https://www.un.org/securitycouncil/): Official site for Security Council meetings, resolutions, and presidency information.
- [International Court of Justice](https://www.un.org/en/about-us/main-bodies#international-court-of-justice): Information on the UN’s principal judicial organ and its role.
- [Disarmament](https://www.un.org/disarmament/): UN Office for Disarmament Affairs resources, treaties, and current initiatives.
- [Counter-Terrorism](https://www.un.org/counterterrorism/): UN coordination, policy, and resources on preventing and countering terrorism.

## Sustainable Development and Climate
- [Sustainable Development Goals](https://www.un.org/sustainabledevelopment/): Official hub for the 2030 Agenda and the 17 Sustainable Development Goals.
- [Climate Action](https://www.un.org/en/climatechange): UN coverage of climate science, negotiations, and action priorities.
- [Economic Development](https://www.un.org/en/global-issues/economic-development): UN work on inclusive growth, financing, and development policy.
- [Food](https://www.un.org/en/global-issues/food): Resources on hunger, food systems, and global food security.
- [Water](https://www.un.org/en/global-issues/water): UN information on freshwater access, sanitation, and water governance.
- [Global Issues](https://www.un.org/en/global-issues): Directory of major UN issue areas from development to migration.

## Human Rights, Humanitarian Affairs, and Social Issues
- [Human Rights](https://www.un.org/en/global-issues/human-rights): Overview of UN human rights norms, mechanisms, and campaigns.
- [Refugees and Migrants](https://www.un.org/en/global-issues/refugees-and-migrants): UN background and resources on displacement and migration.
- [Women](https://www.un.org/en/global-issues/women): UN work on gender equality, women’s rights, and empowerment.
- [Children](https://www.un.org/en/global-issues/children): Information on child rights, protection, and development.
- [Health](https://www.un.org/en/global-issues/health): UN coverage of global health challenges and international cooperation.
- [Humanitarian Aid](https://www.un.org/en/global-issues/humanitarian-aid): Resources on emergency response, relief coordination, and crises.

## UN Organs and System
- [Main Bodies](https://www.un.org/en/about-us/main-bodies): Overview of the General Assembly, Security Council, ECOSOC, ICJ, and Secretariat.
- [General Assembly](https://www.un.org/en/ga/): Official information on sessions, debates, resolutions, and high-level meetings.
- [Economic and Social Council](https://www.un.org/ecosoc/): ECOSOC mandates, meetings, and coordination of economic and social work.
- [Secretariat](https://www.un.org/en/about-us/secretariat): Role and structure of the UN Secretariat and its departments.
- [Secretary-General](https://www.un.org/sg/en): Official site of the UN Secretary-General, statements, and priorities.
- [UN System](https://www.un.org/en/about-us/un-system): Directory of UN funds, programmes, specialized agencies, and related bodies.

## Documents, Research, and Data
- [UN Documents](https://www.un.org/en/documents/): Portal to resolutions, reports, treaties, and foundational texts.
- [Dag Hammarskjöld Library Research Guides](https://research.un.org/en): Research guides for UN documentation, voting, and institutional history.
- [Security Council Research Guide](https://research.un.org/en/docs/sc): Research help for Security Council records, resolutions, and meeting materials.
- [UN Digital Library](https://digitallibrary.un.org/): Search platform for UN documents, voting data, speeches, and publications.
- [Official Document System](https://documents.un.org/): Repository for official UN documents in multiple languages.
- [UN Treaty Collection](https://treaties.un.org/): Database of multilateral treaties, status information, and treaty actions.

## News, Media, and Communications
- [UN News](https://news.un.org/en/): Daily reporting on UN meetings, crises, development, and global issues.
- [Meetings Coverage and Press Releases](https://press.un.org/en): Official press releases and meeting summaries from UN bodies.
- [Media Resources](https://www.un.org/en/media-resources): Multimedia, photos, audio, and broadcast resources from the UN.
- [UN Web TV](https://webtv.un.org/): Live and on-demand video of UN meetings, events, and briefings.
- [Photo](https://www.un.org/en/media/photo): Official UN photography archive and featured images.
- [Podcasts and Audio](https://www.un.org/en/media/audio): UN audio content, interviews, and radio-style programming.

## Country Teams and Regional Presence
- [UN Country Team Websites](https://uninfo.org/country-teams/): Directory of United Nations country team websites worldwide.
- [UN in Bolivia](https://bolivia.un.org/es): Country site with local UN priorities, news, and SDG work.
- [UN in India](https://india.un.org/en): Country site covering UN programmes, partnerships, and national priorities.
- [UN in Kenya](https://kenya.un.org/en): Country site for UN activities, publications, and development cooperation.
- [UN in Lebanon](https://lebanon.un.org/en): Country site with updates on humanitarian, development, and governance work.
- [UN in Ukraine](https://ukraine.un.org/en): Country site focused on UN response, coordination, and country programming.

## Careers, Procurement, and Learning
- [Careers](https://careers.un.org/): UN Secretariat jobs, recruitment information, and application guidance.
- [Procurement Division](https://www.un.org/Depts/ptd/): Vendor registration, tenders, and procurement policies for UN suppliers.
- [United Nations Academic Impact](https://www.un.org/en/academic-impact): Higher education initiative connecting universities with UN principles.
- [UN Careers Portal Help](https://careers.un.org/lbw/home.aspx?viewtype=AYI): Guidance for applicants on profiles, vacancies, and recruitment processes.
- [Peacekeeping Resource Hub](https://peacekeepingresourcehub.un.org/en): Training and guidance materials for peacekeeping personnel and partners.
- [UN System Staff College](https://www.unssc.org/): Learning programmes and knowledge services for UN staff and partners.

## Campaigns, Observances, and Public Engagement
- [International Days and Weeks](https://www.un.org/en/observances/list-days-weeks): Calendar of UN observances, campaigns, and awareness dates.
- [Take Action](https://www.un.org/en/actnow): Public engagement campaign for climate and sustainability action.
- [Visitors Services](https://www.un.org/en/visit): Information on visiting UN Headquarters and guided tours.
- [Model United Nations](https://www.un.org/en/mun): Resources for students and educators participating in Model UN.
- [UN Publications](https://shop.un.org/): Official UN books, reports, and statistical publications.
- [UN Chronicle](https://www.un.org/en/un-chronicle): Magazine-style analysis and commentary on UN priorities and debates.
